_comment: The exceptions to arthome-check-enums, EACH WITH ITS REASON.
This file stays short or the rule is a bad one. Past twenty lines, that is
the sign that a value is missing from @arthome/core — not that the gate is
A legitimate exception has a recognisable shape: the value belongs to a
SPACE SHARED by two distinct vocabularies, and importing the constant would
be SEMANTICALLY WRONG. Any other justification is suspect.

allow.reason: NODE_ENV's deployment mode, not a role on a show. MEMBER_ROLES has a `production` member because somebody works IN production — the crew sense — and the two share the English word without sharing anything else. Importing MEMBER_ROLES.PRODUCTION to describe how a process was started would carve the confusion in rather than correct it. This is the exact shape the gate has produced a bad fix for before: an agent once reached for NavigationEntry.JOURNAL to name an accounting export format, the same string and the wrong concept.
